note: Both sets capture the nine Table 5-1 values with supporting quotes, but each pads the list with duplicate rotor-speed claims (A two, B three). B additionally misbinds the brake time constant to the 'High-Speed Shaft' rather than the brake, and drops the fully-deployed condition on the brake torque that A keeps. B does retain 'rated' conditions on the rotor and generator speeds, but its extra duplicate and misbound entity make A the cleaner set.
